Baked this morning, still warm.

A family bakery in Leeds since 1998. Slow-proved sourdough, buttery pastries and celebration cakes made to order, with real butter and local flour.

Pre-order today's bakesDesign a cake

Today's bakes

Pre-order now and collect from 7am. We bake a set amount each day, so when it's gone, it's gone.

Design your cake

Choose your size, flavour and finish. We need 3 days' notice.

Size
Flavour
Icing

8 inch vanilla cake

Buttercream

£52

Three generations, one oven.

Rosa opened Crumb & Co. with one oven and her mother's recipes. Today her son Daniel bakes through the night, still using the same sourdough starter from 1998.

Everything is made by hand in our kitchen behind the shop. Nothing is frozen, and leftover bread goes to the local food bank every evening.

Questions

How far ahead should I order a cake?

Please order at least 3 days before you need it. For weddings and cakes with more than two tiers, give us 2 weeks.

Do you make gluten-free or vegan bakes?

Yes. We bake gluten-free brownies and vegan banana bread every day, and can make most cakes vegan with 5 days' notice. Our kitchen uses flour and nuts, so we can't promise allergen-free.

Can you deliver?

We deliver cakes within 8 miles of the shop for £6. Bread and pastries are collection only.

# Bakery

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/restaurant/bakery/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
